purpose: Local AMASS/X277/task/repair result 3D viewer, compare player, root/tracker edit project, and current277-compatible task exporter.

backend_modules.visual_editor.models: Dataclasses for StudioConfig, MotionAsset, MotionTrack, compare panes, and edit schema constants.
backend_modules.visual_editor.library: Indexes AMASS, converted X277, materialized task, and repair stream outputs.
backend_modules.visual_editor.decoder: Lazily decodes tracks into a shared frame payload and optional mesh payload.
backend_modules.visual_editor.services: Compare, edit, export, and top-level MotionStudioService orchestration.
backend_modules.visual_editor.x277: X277 decoding, root/tracker keyframe application helpers, and current277 task export.
backend_modules.visual_editor.server: FastAPI REST API and CLI entrypoint.

data_contracts.amass_raw: Raw AMASS npz contains poses, trans, betas, gender, and mocap_framerate. Direct rendering needs local SMPL/SMPL-H assets.
data_contracts.materialized_task: Task npz contains x277, sensor_missing_labels, inpaint_mask, start_frame, valid_length, source_frames, and seq_len.
data_contracts.repair_result: stream_outputs.npz contains reference_motion, conditioned_motion, reconstructed_motion, sensor_missing_labels, inpaint_mask, and valid_frame_mask.
data_contracts.exported_dataset: Export directory contains <split>/manifest.jsonl, <split>/tasks/*.npz, edit_log.json, and dataset_index.json.

maintenance_notes: Do not auto-download SMPL/AMASS licensed assets; default local model lookup is dataset/body_models.
Do not overwrite original datasets or training outputs.
Editor dependencies, caches, runtime files, frame cache, and exports stay inside visual_editor/.
The old /api/samples routes and old SampleRecord UI model were intentionally removed in v0.2.
